verdict.rationale: The closest first-party evidence is the claim that users can manage many video variants and ask the agent to one-shot each, which suggests agent-driven work across multiple items. Kino also says it automatically transcribes and describes every clip. Neither describes a user-invoked bulk operation applied to a selection of many items at once, and smart bins only organize footage. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-select or batch-action capability, a list of supported bulk operations (e.g., batch edit, export, tag, delete), scale or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Manage many variants of your video and ask the agent to one-shot each.
